preliminary_tests.reason: The first Figma run proved account, library and component search connectivity but did not transform the fixed V2 UI benchmark.

trial_order.purpose: Prove that a fixed brief and an explicit director decision improve V2 without adding a new supplier.
Use accessible Korean production websites and GDWEB references.
Use actual Figma Community components on the fixed V2 benchmark.
Test an inspectable visual workbench instead of repeated raster generation.
Test whether searchable resources add value beyond the existing UI UX Pro.
Only test if free and local sources fail to provide product-flow references.
Test an established DESIGN.md preset on a fixed customer community benchmark.
Test implementation-ready community blocks on the same benchmark.
Test motion-led visual differentiation on the same benchmark.
